title: Oven Roasted Indian Peaches Korma
description: A tender and herbal Indian dish featuring peaches, perfect for a date night, this sugar-free-friendly korma is a delicious and healthy option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the diced peaches, chopped onion, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
In a small pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat and add the cumin seeds.
Let the cumin seeds sizzle for a few seconds, then add the coriander powder and stir well.
Add the peach mixture to the pan and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the peaches are roasting, mix together the yogurt, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
After the peaches have roasted for 20 minutes, remove them from the oven and stir in the yogurt mixture.
Return the dish to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
